name: Collapse
description: The first clip shrinks into the center and uncovers the second. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: mode
params.description: 0 = horizontal (closes/opens from the left and right edges), 1 = vertical (top and bottom), 2 = both (box), 3 = circle
